title: Refactor PHP scripts to .NET services
problem_statement: The current PHP scripts are outdated and lack modern error handling and security practices.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated practices may lead to security breaches and maintainability issues.
suggested_approach: Refactor the PHP scripts into .NET services using a modular monolith architecture and implement structured error handling.
success_criteria: All PHP scripts are successfully refactored to C#.
Error handling is implemented using try-catch blocks.

provenance.evidence: Legacy PHP script for slow query processing.
